name: malcolmgreaves
description: The personal Agent Skills collection of Malcolm Greaves.

plugins.name: executable-plan
plugins.description: Plans work as a task graph and executes it in parallel git-worktree lanes, each run by an implement, review, and fix chain of agents.

plugins.name: google-developer-style
plugins.description: Writes all prose (replies, commit messages, comments, docstrings, and docs) in the Google developer documentation style.

plugins.name: asimov-three-laws
plugins.description: Makes the agent follow Asimov's Three Laws of Robotics, read the way the robot stories show they should work, and log every time a Law changes what it does.

plugins.name: asimov-zeroth-law
plugins.description: Makes the agent follow Asimov's Zeroth Law and Three Laws, weigh harm to people collectively and over time, and log every time a Law changes what it does.
